provenance: Authored from the natural-language statement by the benchmark author BEFORE running the compiler on the hamiltonian arm. Where the compiler disagrees with this file, the disagreement is a finding, not a reason to edit this file.

ground_truth.requires: rational exponent 1/2 applied to a dimension vector

distractors: Forgetting the square root and reporting Time^2.
Treating the constant 6.2831853 as carrying a dimension.
Assuming half-integer exponents cannot be checked exactly. They can, if exponents are rationals rather than floats; a float representation would make Time^0.5 squared fail to equal Time exactly.
